title: 高三单遍：面包、地图与渡船
source_notice: 参照高三山东公开读者层第一节：五独立短对话各一题三选、每段一遍、听后十秒兼作本题作答与读下一题，本节未印已解示例。网页称期中，正文为2025届第二次诊断/2024.11，原校发布未认证；题面、印出脚本和键可核，原录音缺，普通HTTP500，不绕门取文件。与高三既有两遍/已解示例模式分开，不能按年级统一复用播放次数。全部对话、问题、候选和合成音轨为原创；本机审阅可重播，不当自然语流、年级/难度等值、独立教研、学生、商用或生产通过。
instruction: 听五段独立短对话，每段一题，从A、B、C中选最佳答案。每段一遍，听后10秒兼作本题作答与读下一题；本组不含已解示例。审阅页面可重播。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I ordered twenty bread rolls for eleven o’clock. Are they ready?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Twelve are in this bag. The other eight are still in the oven, but they’ll be out in ten minutes.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: That’s all right. I’m a little early anyway.

questions.stem: How many bread rolls are still being baked?
questions.rationale: A：other eight still in oven明确八个未出炉；B：十二个已在袋中；C：二十是总订单，不是仍在烤的数量

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: I can’t find the walking maps. Aren’t they usually in the top drawer?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: They were, but we moved them to the shelf beside the office door yesterday. The drawer now holds spare keys.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Thanks. I’ll look on the shelf.

options: On a shelf by the office door.
Beside the spare keys in a box.
questions.rationale: A：抽屉是旧位置，已放备用钥匙；B：昨天迁至门边架上，末句确认；C：钥匙在抽屉，不与地图同在箱中

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: It’s getting warm in here. Shall I open the window?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: The traffic noise would make it hard to hear the recording. Could we use the fan instead?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Good idea. I’ll switch it on and leave the window shut.

questions.stem: What do the speakers decide to do?
options: Open the window despite the noise.
Use the fan with the window closed.
questions.rationale: A：他们保护录音可听性，未停听；B：明确leave window shut；C：switch fan on且关窗，两句一致

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: I’ve reached the harbour, but there’s a notice saying today’s ferry has been cancelled.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Yes, the wind is too strong. Your ticket will be valid tomorrow if the weather improves.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: I’ll check the forecast before making another trip down here.

questions.stem: Why is the woman unable to take the ferry today?
options: She has arrived after its departure.
Strong wind has stopped the service.
Her ticket is valid only next week.
questions.rationale: A：已取消而非已经开走；B：wind too strong为直接原因；C：票可用于明天，不是下周才有效

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Would you like to join us on the coastal walk this Saturday? The weather should be lovely.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: I’d love to, but I’ve promised to help my brother move into his new flat. Could you tell me when you plan the next walk?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Of course. I’ll let you know.

questions.stem: Why does the woman decline the invitation?
options: She has a prior family commitment.
She dislikes walking near the sea.
She expects bad weather that day.
questions.rationale: A：已答应帮弟兄搬家，A准确；B：I’d love to且问下次说明非讨厌；C：天气预报lovely，并非预计坏天气
